verdict.rationale: Drata clearly has a trust center (SafeBase branding/URL setup, analytics dashboard). However, nothing in the pack shows the trust center automatically syncing subprocessor lists, document renewals, or control status from the platform. The only related claim is that the trust center can be managed 'programmatically' through the API, which is a developer building block for constructing updates, not documented automatic syncing, so it earns no credit.
